transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… my eating’s been really off. I stopped keeping track of it like I usually do, and I’ve been skipping actual meals. Mostly coffee, protein bars… that kind of thing. My clothes started getting loose before I really paid attention.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
Yeah… I think so. I wasn’t really weighing myself, but I stopped eating proper meals for a while—mostly coffee and protein bars—and my clothes started hanging loose.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I haven’t been thinking about it that way.
Do you think you would be upset if you gained weight?
I’m not sure. I mean… I don’t think I’d be that upset, but I haven’t really thought about it much.
Have you had any episodes where you ate a lot of food in a short amount of time?

Not really eating a lot, no. It was more the opposite… I kind of stopped keeping track and skipped actual meals. Mostly just coffee and protein bars for days. My clothes got loose before I really noticed.
Are you ever worried that you might gain weight?
Not really. I mean… I haven’t been worried about that, no.
Have you ever felt like you couldn't stop eating once you started?

No… not really. It was more that I wasn’t eating much at all. I stopped paying attention to meals and was just having coffee and protein bars for a while. My clothes got loose before I really noticed.
Do you think gaining weight would be a bad thing for you?
I don’t really think about it like that. I mean, I don’t want to feel unhealthy or anything, but gaining weight isn’t something I’m especially afraid of.
Do you think you would be anxious or nervous if you were to gain back the weight you lost?

No, I don’t think I’d be nervous about gaining it back. It wasn’t really about weight for me. My eating just got… messed up. I stopped tracking anything, skipped real meals, mostly coffee and protein bars, and then my clothes were loose before I even noticed.
Do you think your eating habits changed because of stress, emotions, or other personal issues?

Maybe. I’m not totally sure what set it off. I just kind of stopped caring about tracking food or making real meals… went days mostly on coffee and protein bars. I didn’t really notice how much it had changed until my clothes were hanging loose.
Was there something specific that was bothering you or stressing you out when you stopped tracking your food and switched to mostly coffee and protein bars?

I don’t know if there was one specific thing. It was more like… I just stopped caring about the food tracking, stopped making real meals. Then it became coffee and protein bars for days, and I didn’t really notice how far it had gone until my clothes were loose.
Do you think your change in eating habits was related to any emotional issues you were experiencing?

Maybe. I don’t really know if it was “emotional” exactly. I just… stopped caring about keeping up with food, stopped making meals, and went days with coffee and protein bars. It got pretty out of hand before I noticed my clothes were hanging loose.
Did you simply lose interest in eating or food when you started skipping meals?

Yeah… I guess I kind of lost interest. I wasn’t really thinking about food much. I just stopped tracking it, stopped making meals, and then it was mostly coffee and protein bars for days. I didn’t really clock how bad it got until my clothes were loose.
Was losing interest in eating the main reason you stopped tracking your food and switched to mostly coffee and protein bars?

Yeah… mostly. I just stopped caring about tracking it or making real food. It turned into coffee and protein bars for days, and I didn’t really notice how bad it was until my clothes were hanging loose.
Did you lose interest in eating because something else was on your mind or was it just a general lack of interest in food itself?

I think it was more… general. Not just food. I haven’t really wanted to hike, edit photos, keep up with meals, or even touch the woodworking thing in the garage. Those usually help me stay steady, so… yeah, it’s been weird.
Have you lost interest in other activities besides eating?

Yeah. I haven’t really wanted to hike, edit photos… even log meals. There’s a woodworking project sitting in the garage too, and I just haven’t touched it. Those things usually help keep me grounded, so… it’s odd.
Have you felt this way about your hobbies and interests for a long time?
Yeah… it’s been a while. Since the project crisis, I guess. Maybe around three months. It’s just been this… hollow, ashamed feeling, and I haven’t really cared about much.
Is this lack of interest in your hobbies and other activities still going on?

Yeah… it’s still going on. I still don’t really want to hike or edit photos, and the woodworking project’s just sitting there. I haven’t even been keeping up with logging meals much. It’s… not like me.
Do you feel sad or empty most of the time?

Yeah… most of the time, I guess. After the sponsor questioned my judgment, it felt like the bottom just dropped out. I’d sit in my apartment feeling… hollow. Ashamed. I even cried over emails I normally would’ve just dealt with.
Do you feel like you've lost pleasure in things you used to enjoy most of the time?

Yeah. I mean… most of the time, I don’t really get anything out of the stuff I used to. Hiking, photos, logging meals… even the woodworking thing in the garage. I just haven’t wanted to touch any of it, which is… unusual for me.
